name: Living Water
overview: Scripture reveals that 'Living Water' symbolizes the sustaining and renewing provision of God for His people, who are called to draw joyfully from the wells of salvation (Isaiah 12:3). God promises to pour out His Spirit like water upon the thirsty, blessing and satisfying the soul even in spiritual drought (Isaiah 44:3; 58:11). The prophet Jeremiah highlights the folly of forsaking God, the true fountain of living waters, in favor of empty, broken cisterns (Jeremiah 2:13). Jesus, identifying Himself as the source of living water, offers this gift to all who believe, though those who rely on earthly things will continue to thirst (John 4:10, 13).
